name: DEBUG NMR + EnGrad (HF/STO-3G, ~free)
template:
# DEBUG NMR shielding + gradient — HF/STO-3G, 1 core. Cheap displaced
# single-point for testing the ZPVA node end-to-end (keeps both NMR and EnGrad).
# Computes 1H shieldings so it works on any molecule with hydrogens. NOT for
# chemistry. For ZPVA set the node's property=nmr_shielding, target=H.

! HF STO-3G NMR EnGrad

%maxcore 1000

%pal nprocs 1
end

!!##COORDS_SEC##!!

%eprnmr
   NUCLEI = ALL H { SHIFT }
END
